r2_launcher.why: infrastructure only: runner, frozen bank, prompt template, prompts, budgets and physics are all identical to launch_trial.sh
hardening: refuses to start when the attempt dir already exists (ATTEMPT_DIR_EXISTS, exit 4) - removes the FileExistsError failure mode seen on resume

public mailbox root /tmp/bowl-qwen38flash-r2-20260915-1730/<trial> instead of the 5-slot root, so a stale mailbox from the previous window can never be mistaken for a new runner's READY (this is what silently attached a second policy worker to trial-06/07 during the 17:11 auto-resume)

scheduling.orchestrator: pi workflow run bowl_qwen_r2_pool2; per trial two agent() calls: (1) infrastructure launcher (.pi/agents/bowl-launcher.md, tools=bash only, sha256 05b16ebf425c8dcfed914e0e6caa83f4f85400e4a9a9ec3de6e7e5b3cb9b1d6a) runs launch_trial_r2.sh <index> and waits for the first canonical request, (2) policy worker (.pi/agents/bowl-policy.md, tools=read+bash, model qwen-token-plan-cn/qwen3.8-flash, thinking=medium, sha256 a8dea3c156430909a50a1657551a89e2ea28cf0a949d4cbe3ad9246a7c72931a) drives the whole trial through subagent_mailbox.py
scheduling.launcher_is_not_a_decision_maker: the launcher agent never sees a policy request and never chooses a robot action; all robot decisions come from the qwen3.8-flash policy worker
scheduling.retries: agent retries disabled (0); an agent failure leaves the runner to error out and the whole trial is re-run from the same frozen initialization as a new attempt per SOP section 8
